# Data Description
- Author: 蔡睿燊
- Date first created: 20261108（本 Parquet 檔建立日；兩年 CSV 分別於 2026-10-18、2026-11-08 產生）
- Background: 中央氣象署局屬氣象站「臺北」測站（`StationID` = `466920`，臺北市中正區，距臺大約 2.5 km）2024–2025 年的逐時溫度、相對濕度與降雨資料，原始資料取自 TDX 局屬氣象站天氣觀測報告（每日一檔、每 10 分鐘左右一筆觀測）。兩年各自由上游 Rmd 整理成逐時格點後，在本次直向合併為單一檔案，供與 YouBike 站點 × 小時資料以 `datetime` 合併。選用臺北站而非臺灣大學站（`A0A010`）的理由見 [`weather_taipei_2024.Rmd`](../../code/weather_taipei_2024.Rmd)（組員 2026-10-18 決定）。
- Unit of observation: 一個整點時間格點 `datetime` = t，代表區間 (t − 60 分鐘, t]（臺北站單一測站，故每列即一個小時）。
- Sample period: 2024-01-01 00:00 至 2025-12-31 23:00（`Asia/Taipei` 當地時間），共 17,544 小時（2024 年 8,784、2025 年 8,760）。
- Known issues:
    - 缺值不補：區間內沒有有效觀測時為 `NA`。`Temp`／`HUMD` 缺 201 小時（2024 年 46、2025 年 155）；`D24R`／`D24R_trace` 缺 309 小時；`rain` 缺 320 小時（2024 年 91、2025 年 229）。2025 年缺值明顯較多。
    - `D24R` = `-990` 被解讀為「雨跡」（有降雨但未達 0.5 mm），記為 `D24R` = 0 並以 `D24R_trace` = TRUE 標示。這是依資料型態的推論，**尚未在 CWA／TDX 文件中確認**。
    - `rain` 依組員定義只看區間內 `D24R` 有無變動：「由 0 變成雨跡」算 1，少數「雨跡退回 0」的下降也算 1；`D24R` 有變動但區間起點讀數早於 t − 120 分鐘時記為 `NA`。
    - 2024、2025 年各自處理。2025-01-01 00:00 的區間屬於 2024-12-31 的雨量累積日，2025 年程式以起點 0 計算；已在 [合併程式](../../code/weather_taipei_combine_2024_2025.Rmd) 確認該處 `D24R` 前後皆為 0，`rain` = 0 無誤。
    - 單一測站讀數，不代表研究範圍內每個 YouBike 站點的局部天氣。
- Definition for each variable:
    - `datetime`：時間格點 t（`timestamp[us, tz=Asia/Taipei]`；R 讀入為 `POSIXct`，Python／pandas 為 tz-aware `datetime64`）。代表區間 (t − 60 分鐘, t]，唯一鍵。
    - `Temp`：氣溫（°C），區間內最後一筆有效觀測；無則 `NA`。
    - `HUMD`：相對濕度，沿用原始 0–1 比例（例如 0.62 = 62%），區間內最後一筆有效觀測；無則 `NA`。
    - `D24R`：當日累積雨量（mm），自當日 00:00 起累積（00:00 那筆仍是前一天全日總量），區間內最後一筆有效觀測；`-99` 轉 `NA`，雨跡 `-990` 記為 0。
    - `D24R_trace`：logical，該筆 `D24R` 原始值是否為雨跡 `-990`；與 `D24R` 同時缺值。
    - `rain`：integer 降雨指標，區間內 `D24R` 有變動為 1、無變動為 0；終點 `D24R` 缺值或變動時點無法判定為 `NA`。
- Data path: `data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet` (the exact file this notebook reads)
- Source data: `data/processed/weather_taipei_2024_hourly.csv`、`data/processed/weather_taipei_2025_hourly.csv`（再往上游為 `data/raw/weather_raw/` 中 2024、2025 年每日原始檔，逐檔 SHA-256 列於 `data/code/weather_raw_manifest.csv` 與 `data/code/weather_raw_manifest_2025.csv`）
- Processing code: `data/code/weather_taipei_combine_2024_2025.Rmd`（合併；兩年 CSV 分別由 `data/code/weather_taipei_2024.Rmd`、`data/code/weather_taipei_2025.Rmd` 產生）
- Role: `analysis`
- Verification status: 2026-11-08 乾淨 R 程序 knit 本文件：SHA-256 相符；6 欄、17,544 列、欄位型態符合；`datetime` 不重複且逐時連續；`HUMD` 介於 0–1、`D24R` ≥ 0、`rain` 只有 0／1／`NA`、`D24R_trace` 與 `D24R` 同時缺值、`D24R` 缺值時 `rain` 必為 `NA`，全部通過。
- SHA-256: `3d673f5e42f30ece48d514556d8c3c22848533b41c9a44ae543a20243a8e7000`
- Downstream analysis input: `data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet` (must equal Data path)

Keep these paths and the `PROJECT-PROPOSAL.md` Data Artifacts row consistent. The source
and processing links describe lineage; later finding notebooks read this exact
processed file. For train/test data, document each file and its role separately.

讀取 Parquet 使用 `arrow` 套件（tidyverse 沒有 Parquet 讀取功能）。

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}

```

## Change for Your Own Data

```{r}
INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH <- "data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet"
input_data_file <- project_file(INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, "processed")
EXPECTED_COLUMNS <- c("datetime", "Temp", "HUMD", "D24R", "D24R_trace", "rain")
EXPECTED_ROWS <- 17544L # 8,784 (2024) + 8,760 (2025) hours.
EXPECTED_SHA256 <- "3d673f5e42f30ece48d514556d8c3c22848533b41c9a44ae543a20243a8e7000"
```

## Summary

```{r}
input_fingerprint <- verify_input_sha256(input_data_file, EXPECTED_SHA256)
df <- read_parquet(input_data_file)
print(list(data_path = INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, rows = nrow(df),
           schema = vapply(df, function(x) paste(class(x), collapse = "/"), character(1)),
           time_zone = attr(df$datetime, "tzone"),
           sha256 = sha256_file(input_data_file)))
```

### Summary Stats

```{r}
summary(df)
```

各年份的有效 N 與缺值數（百分比分母為該年小時數）：

```{r}
df |>
  mutate(year = year(datetime)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    hours = n(),
    temp_missing = sum(is.na(Temp)),
    humd_missing = sum(is.na(HUMD)),
    d24r_missing = sum(is.na(D24R)),
    rain_missing = sum(is.na(rain)),
    rain_missing_pct = round(100 * mean(is.na(rain)), 2)
  )
```

數值欄位的分布（N 為非缺值小時數）：

```{r}
df |>
  select(Temp, HUMD, D24R) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = sum(!is.na(value)),
    missing = sum(is.na(value))
  )
```

`rain` 與 `D24R_trace` 的次數（比例分母為全部 17,544 小時，含 `NA`）：

```{r}
df |>
  mutate(year = year(datetime)) |>
  count(year, rain) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(share = round(n / sum(n), 4)) |>
  ungroup()

df |>
  count(D24R_trace) |>
  mutate(share = round(n / sum(n), 4))
```

### Assertions

```{r}
if (length(EXPECTED_COLUMNS) == 0L || any(grepl("<", EXPECTED_COLUMNS, fixed = TRUE))) {
  stop("Fill the expected schema and dataset-specific assertions before verification.")
}
stopifnot(identical(names(df), EXPECTED_COLUMNS))
if (!is.null(EXPECTED_ROWS)) stopifnot(nrow(df) == EXPECTED_ROWS)

# Types written by the processing notebook.
stopifnot(
  inherits(df$datetime, "POSIXct"),
  identical(attr(df$datetime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei"),
  is.double(df$Temp),
  is.double(df$HUMD),
  is.double(df$D24R),
  is.logical(df$D24R_trace),
  is.integer(df$rain)
)

# Key: one row per hour, continuous from 2024-01-01 00:00 to 2025-12-31 23:00.
expected_grid <- seq(
  ymd_hms("2024-01-01 00:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
  ymd_hms("2025-12-31 23:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
  by = "hour"
)
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(df$datetime),
  !anyDuplicated(df$datetime),
  all(df$datetime == expected_grid)
)

# Value rules documented by the upstream processing notebooks.
stopifnot(
  all(between(df$HUMD, 0, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
  all(df$D24R >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(df$rain %in% c(0L, 1L, NA)),
  identical(is.na(df$D24R), is.na(df$D24R_trace)),
  all(is.na(df$rain[is.na(df$D24R)]))
)

actual_sha256 <- sha256_file(input_data_file)
if (!identical(actual_sha256, input_fingerprint)) stop("File changed during documentation: inspect the new version.")
print(list(data_path = INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, rows = nrow(df), columns = names(df),
           sha256 = actual_sha256,
           status = "configured checks passed"))
```
